mha_i4c.title: Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting & Management System (CFCFRMS / 1930)
mha_i4c.authority: Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs
mha_i4c.description: National helpline 1930 and inter-bank automated transaction freeze and tracing network.

ncrp_portal.title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
ncrp_portal.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
ncrp_portal.description: Official national portal for lodging cyber crime and financial fraud complaints.

rbi_customer_liability.title: Customer Protection – Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions
rbi_customer_liability.authority: Reserve Bank of India (RBI Circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18)
rbi_customer_liability.description: Statutory rules establishing zero/limited customer liability when unauthorized electronic transactions are reported promptly to banks.

npci_upi_safety.title: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Safety Guidelines & Dispute Resolution
npci_upi_safety.description: UPI transaction protocols, PIN entry safety rules, and transaction dispute workflows.

dot_sancharsaathi.title: Sanchar Saathi & Chakshu Citizen Reporting Facility
dot_sancharsaathi.authority: Department of Telecommunications (DoT), Ministry of Communications
dot_sancharsaathi.description: Portal for reporting suspected fraud SMS, fraudulent calls, and lost/swapped mobile connections.
